description: Open a hard budget for one agent run before it starts: max dollars, tokens, calls and/or wall-clock seconds. Returns a handle. Give the handle to every sub-agent; they all draw from the same ledger, so one runaway loop or fork cannot exceed the run cap.

label.description: What this run is for, e.g. "nightly code cleanup".

max_calls.description: Cap on model/tool calls for the whole run.

max_seconds.description: Wall-clock cap in seconds from now.

max_tokens.description: Token cap (input + output) for the whole run.

max_usd.description: Dollar cap for the whole run (your own estimates per call).

mode.description: shadow = watch only: track spend and flag where the cap WOULD have stopped the run, never block (free). enforce = return allowed=false at the cap (Pro). Default: enforce on Pro, shadow on free.

ttl_hours.description: Handle lifetime (free max 24, Pro max 168). Default 24.

name: open_budget
